entities.name: Q6LH19
observations: Reviewed Photobacterium profundum glycine/sarcosine/betaine reductase complex component A2; query is an exact 161-residue sequence match.
Contains a selenocysteine (U); GRDA Pfam domain PF04723 spans residues 2–148 in the query.
UniProt reference associates this component with reductive deamination of glycine, sarcosine, and betaine substrates in the multicomponent reductase system; mechanistic description is by similarity.

entities.name: Glycine reductase complex
observations: Multicomponent reductase system associated with glycine, sarcosine, and betaine reductase activities.
